text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne. I have 7 years of experience building full stack web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

Your idea makes a lot of sense: an all-in-one platform that brings together AI tools, product generation, and print-on-demand workflows for store owners who want to move fast without juggling multiple services. I’d approach it as a clean, compact product with a strong workflow around AI-assisted ideation, image generation, product creation, and API integrations for Printify/Printful.

One relevant project I built was a Monthly statement PDF generator for Alder Property Group. I created a queue that renders owner statements to PDF overnight and stores them in S3 instead of building them on request, which handled 12k statements a month and took request timeouts from daily to none.

I’d be glad to discuss the best way to scope this MVP.
